text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan hasn't shown up for
training, so I go
looking for her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorryyy! I was in the mood for
something
sweet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm feeling a teensy bit tired. You get
like that
sometimes too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm feeling a teensy bit tired. You get

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! Two Fluffy Strawberry
Parfaits!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu! ♪ Do you want one, Big
Bro?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu! ♪ Do you want one, Big
Sis?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I dunno if I can eat two all by myself,
but I don't
wanna waste it... so let's eat
them together.

...It's not like the parfait did anything
wrong. I
accept it, but I still lecture her
about skipping
training.
